description: Search what Basis can do: indicators, formula functions, built-in strategies, the extra series available inside strategy expressions, and the drawing tools with the number of anchors each one takes. This is a catalogue of chart objects, not callable agent functions: use tools_load for function groups. Exact counts are in the system prompt catalogue. Use this before assuming something does or does not exist — and always before drawing a new type, because a drawing tool id you guessed is refused. Reuse a type already verified in this conversation. An empty query lists a kind; no kind searches them all.
